releases.notes:
**Universal Graves 2.1.0 for 1.19**
- Added way for players to teleport to their graves ( @qpcrummer#7194 and @KJP12#3880 )
- You can set teleportation cost to block it for non-creative (default), require lvls/items or be free
- Swiched claim checks to use Common Protection API. If you have a claim/protection mod you should implement support for it ( https://github.com/Patbox/common-protection-api )

**Curseforge**: <https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/universal-graves>
**Github**: <https://github.com/Patbox/UniversalGraves>
